# Venmo Revenue and Usage Statistics (2026)
## Venmo Key Statistics
- Venmo processed $276 billion in total payment volume in 2023, a 13.1% increase year-on-year
- Venmo made an estimated $1.1 billion in 2023, an 18.2% increase on 2023 figures
- 83 million people used Venmo in 2023, most users are based in the United States
- PayPal acquired Venmo in 2013 for $800 million, as part of its acquisition of Braintree

# PayPal and Venmo Taxes: What You Need to Know About P2P Platforms
[![](https://digitalasset.intuit.com/render/content/dam/intuit/cg/en_us/images/icons/link.svg)](https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/self-employment-taxes/paypal-and-venmo-taxes-what-you-need-to-know-about-p2p-platforms/L5DNjOUM1#popovers/copiedToClipboard)[![](https://digitalasset.intuit.com/render/content/dam/intuit/cg/en_us/images/icons/facebook-logo.svg)](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/self-employment-taxes/paypal-and-venmo-taxes-what-you-need-to-know-about-p2p-platforms/L5DNjOUM1)[![](https://digitalasset.intuit.com/render/content/dam/intuit/cg/en_us/images/icons/twitter-logo.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/self-employment-taxes/paypal-and-venmo-taxes-what-you-need-to-know-about-p2p-platforms/L5DNjOUM1)[![](https://digitalasset.intuit.com/render/content/dam/intuit/cg/en_us/images/icons/linkedin-logo.svg)](http://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/self-employment-taxes/paypal-and-venmo-taxes-what-you-need-to-know-about-p2p-platforms/L5DNjOUM1)[![](https://digitalasset.intuit.com/render/content/dam/intuit/cg/en_us/images/icons/reddit-logo.svg)](https://www.reddit.com/submit?url=https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/self-employment-taxes/paypal-and-venmo-taxes-what-you-need-to-know-about-p2p-platforms/L5DNjOUM1)[![](https://digitalasset.intuit.com/render/content/dam/intuit/cg/en_us/images/icons/threads-logo.svg)](https://www.threads.net/intent/post?url=https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/self-employment-taxes/paypal-and-venmo-taxes-what-you-need-to-know-about-p2p-platforms/L5DNjOUM1)

OVERVIEW

### Reporting income
People sending money back and forth for their share of dinner don't have to worry about reporting such payments on their tax returns. However, the moment you begin accepting business payments on a P2P platform, you're responsible for reporting that income. P2P payment platforms, including PayPal, Venmo, Stripe, and others, are required to provide information to the IRS about customers who receive payments for the sale of goods and services through those platforms.

- more than $20,000 in gross payment volume
- from more than 200 separate payments in a calendar year

There is no threshold for payment card transactions such as credit card swipes.

The IRS has been gradually phasing in new 1099-K reporting requirements for payments from third-party processors like Venmo and Paypal. In 2021, Congress changed the reporting threshold from more than $20,000 in payments and more than 200 transactions to over $600 in payments regardless of the number of transactions. But instead of using the new $600 threshold right away, the IRS applied the previous reporting threshold for the 2022 and 2023 tax years. For the 2024 tax year, the IRS is using a $5,000 threshold, regardless of the number of transactions. The [One Big Beautiful Bill](https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/general/taxes-2021-7-upcoming-tax-law-changes/L3xFucBvV) passed by Congress in July of 2025, changes the threshold back to more than $20,000 in payments and more than 200 transactions for the 2025 tax year and retroactively for tax years beginning with 2022.

If you cross this threshold, the platform is required to send [Form 1099-K](https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/small-business-taxes/what-online-business-owners-should-know-about-irs-form-1099-k/L2tODOz3r) to you and the IRS in the following year.

# Get growing with social payments
PayPal Editorial StaffPayPal Editorial Staff

July 7, 2025

July 7, 2025

4 mins read

Smartphones and social media let consumers shop anytime. From anywhere. In the US, the social commerce market is forecasted to generate $104 billion in revenue in 2025.1 And it’s expected to surpass $150 billion in 2029.2

Social payment platforms like [Venmo can help](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/checkout-optimization-for-genz-shoppers) businesses tap into this growing market. With Venmo, businesses can streamline transactions. They can grow their reach with new customers. And they can turn existing customers into connections to build loyalty and generate buzz.

## Meet the ultimate social commerce influencers
- 50% of Gen Z and Millennials say they use peer-to-peer (P2P) payment apps like Venmo for both in-store and online purchases.4

## Tap into the power of Venmo
Ones that align with their busy lifestyles.

### Reach new customers
Venmo does more than enable small transactions among friends. One that values convenience, social integration, and modern financial experiences.

- There are 95.4M active Venmo accounts in the US5
- 68% are Gen Z or Millennials6
- 47% are in high-income households7

### Streamline transactions
Venmo helps businesses meet customers where they are: online, in-store, or on their mobile phones.

Then, they can easily pay on the go without entering their payment details. It’s especially appealing to digital natives, who overwhelmingly prefer digital payments to cash.8

### Turn shares into sales
Their friends can like and comment on their activity.

## Get paid and grow with Venmo
Venmo can help your business [get paid and get growing](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/reach-digitally-active-consumers-with-venmo?utm_medium=linkedin&utm_source=social&utm_campaign=socialamplification) with the digital-native customers driving social commerce trends.

Ready to unlock the power of social payments to expand your reach? See how PayPal Open can power your business.

# How Venmo can help expand your reach
PayPal Editorial StaffPayPal Editorial Staff

December 17, 2024

December 17, 2024

3 mins read

Millennial and Gen Z shoppers make up around 42% of US consumers1 — and their push for simple, convenient digital payment methods is transforming checkout.

## Reach new mobile-first consumers
These mobile-first consumers prefer seamless social experiences, even when it comes to payment. They want an easy way to split the bill at dinner and post about their purchases on their socials — and they prefer digital payments to cash.3

## New customers for Adorama, thanks to Venmo
- 92 million active Venmo users4
- 66% Gen Z or Millennial5
- 61% not already PayPal users6

Best of all, Venmo’s active users have a 73% conversion rate.7 And they’re highly engaged with Venmo — it’s mentioned on social media every nine seconds.8

## Make Venmo work for your business
### Tap into customers’ ‘fun money’
And active users who keep a Venmo balance had an average of $211 there each month in 2023.9 Making it easier for customers to spend their “fun money” with your business can help boost sales, especially for products or services that could be impulse buys.
